message: Hi, my son Milo is 6. Can he try a jiu jitsu class?
Hi! Yes, absolutely! We have a Kids Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu program that's perfect for 6-year-olds. Milo can come try a free trial class with no commitment. Would you like to get that set up?
Yes, please! That sounds great. When can we schedule the trial class?
Perfect! I just need a few quick details to get your trial set up. What's your name?
Great, thanks Tester! And what's Milo's date of birth? That helps me find the right class times for his age group.

Perfect! Milo is 6, so he'll be in our Kids 6-7 Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu class.
Let me grab your email and phone number real quick, then I'll show you some available times.
Sure! My email is tester.sorrel@gmail.com and my phone number is 860-555-0399.

Got it, thanks! Here are some open times for Milo's trial class:

Wednesday, July 8 at 5:00 PM
Monday, July 13 at 5:00 PM

Which works better for you?
Let's go with Wednesday, July 8 at 5:00 PM.
Perfect! Milo is all set for Wednesday, July 8 at 5:00 PM for his free trial class. We're located at 15 Cheryl Dr d in Canton. Just have him wear comfortable clothes he can move in. See you then!
